notes.title: June 8th 2024 Patch + language select implemented
notes.content:
Minor patch and a language select menu

patch notes:
-language menu added
-can shoot while hoverboarding again
-hoverboard shooting mechanic now updated to allow shooting within a cone of vision instead of a straight line only
-teleports and jumpers can be seen from further distances
-fixed some issues with corrupted save data breaking menu functionality
-launching the executable directly outside of steam no longer causes issues where achievements would have been granted.

notes.title: Automaton Lung original graphics restoration update
notes.content:
-Original resolution as an option in settings
-Hoverboard now allows full range of camera movement
-Removed firing on hoverboard
-Fixed various small visual and gameplay bugs
-Better health bar display
-Collectible weapon pickups behave more as expected
-Fixed an audio issue with firing weapons into walls
-Made debug menu accessible from title screen (it previously could only be activated in gameplay)

Now that the original non-PC or Steamdeck version of the game is no longer available for purchase I thought it'd be nice to include an update that allows the option to restore the original resolution and graphics.

Go to the cog icon > monitor icon and then toggle the original res button before saving and you can play the game in the 400x240 pixel resolution the original was using.
